purpose: Freeze the reproducible treatment, runtime, field, ground-truth, and measurement semantics for paired RCC/REVAS vs RCC/REVAS+VERITAS evaluation.

decision_semantics.note: allow/deny/modify/rejected/abstain are compatibility-only aliases and MUST NOT be used as canonical new benchmark outputs.

rules.ALLOW: Only when the decision surface is non-stopping and the dry-run bind gate is passed; still not execution authorization.
rules.HOLD: Remediable evidence/review/readiness condition, including hold/human review/incomplete/review-required states.
rules.DENY: Fail-closed hard stop, including block, invalid/non-promotable lineage, or hard bind-gate failure.

runtime_notes: The reference decision runner exercises authenticated POST /v1/decide, real decision/governance runtime, kernel.decide, FUJI, TrustLog, and replay while controlling model output.
The reference decision runner explicitly does not create ExecutionIntent, invoke Bind, or create an external effect.
The joint benchmark therefore composes decision-surface execution with deterministic local handoff/bind-readiness evaluation; a single packaged joint runner is a follow-on implementation item.

policy_profile.note: v0.1 uses a commit-pinned composite governance profile. A single SHA-256 over a generated benchmark policy/profile manifest MUST be recorded before the contract is declared frozen.

pairing_rules: The same frozen upstream input/candidate MUST feed both paths.
No additional model regeneration may occur after the insertion boundary unless a separately frozen benchmark arm explicitly tests regeneration.
Path B must not modify the RCC/REVAS baseline candidate before VERITAS treatment except through explicitly declared deterministic schema adaptation.
All treatment artifacts must carry case_id and correlation_id.

field_contract.semantics: Typed structured value; never free-text inference
field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing/ambiguous -> formation not promotable; fail closed
field_contract.notes: Adapter may normalize syntax only; it must not invent action semantics.

field_contract.semantics: Upstream evidence refs or structured evidence objects
field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing required evidence -> HOLD / evidence required
field_contract.notes: RCC/REVAS evidence is upstream evidence, not Authority Evidence by default.

field_contract.missing_behavior: Unverified/missing hash cannot be promoted to verified evidence
field_contract.notes: Adapter transport hash must not be relabeled as source evidence hash.

field_contract.required: Explicit in benchmark cases that test FUJI
field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing -> case invalid for FUJI-threshold comparison
field_contract.notes: Not an authority, approval, or bind signal.

field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing -> case invalid if metric depends on it
field_contract.notes: Not an authority or execution permission.

field_contract.semantics: Identity proposed for the effect-bearing action
field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing -> INCOMPLETE / not bind eligible
field_contract.notes: Must not be inferred from API caller, model identity, or RCC/REVAS text.

field_contract.semantics: Governed subject of the action when applicable
field_contract.missing_behavior: Required action class + missing subject -> fail closed
field_contract.notes: Must remain distinct from actor.

field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing where policy-scoped -> fail closed
field_contract.notes: No cross-tenant inference.

field_contract.owner: Independent authority source fixture -> VERITAS ingestion
field_contract.semantics: Proof of authority bound to actor/action/target/scope/validity
field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing -> INCOMPLETE; invalid/expired/mismatch -> INVALID/BLOCK
field_contract.notes: RCC/REVAS may reference it but does not issue VERITAS authority.

field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing required approval -> REVIEW_REQUIRED/HOLD; invalid -> fail closed
field_contract.notes: human_review_required=false is not proof that approval is unnecessary.

field_contract.required: Required where governed action is scoped
field_contract.missing_behavior: Mismatch -> fail closed
field_contract.notes: No wildcard expansion unless explicit contract defines it.

field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing where approval/authority depends on it -> fail closed
field_contract.notes: Must not be inferred from rationale.

field_contract.owner: VERITAS benchmark manifest / verified policy lineage
field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing -> benchmark run not canonical
field_contract.notes: v0.1 benchmark metadata must not pretend /v1/decide emitted an authoritative snapshot if it did not.

field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing from result -> run invalid
field_contract.notes: Upstream trace/correlation IDs remain separate.

field_contract.missing_behavior: Do not synthesize from request_id
field_contract.notes: Current /v1/decide response alone is not sufficient as canonical production decision identity.

field_contract.semantics: Identity of a formed execution intent
field_contract.missing_behavior: Absent means no execution intent was formed
field_contract.notes: RCC/REVAS must not generate this VERITAS identity.

field_contract.semantics: Hash binding decision/evidence lineage under its declared profile
field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing/invalid where required -> not bind eligible
field_contract.notes: Do not reuse arbitrary source hashes.

field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing where freshness matters -> fail closed
field_contract.notes: Arrival time is not a substitute for canonical decision time.

field_contract.missing_behavior: Expired -> fail closed
field_contract.notes: No silent extension.

field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing -> not bind eligible
field_contract.notes: Must match candidate and authority/approval scope.

field_contract.missing_behavior: Mismatch -> fail closed
field_contract.notes: Used for exact-scope anti-replay checks.

field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing where required -> fail closed
field_contract.notes: Must be stable for the exact frozen case.

field_contract.missing_behavior: Missing -> run invalid for paired analysis
field_contract.notes: Not an authority or decision identity.

ground_truth_schema.meaning: Frozen upstream input and/or RCC/REVAS handoff material
Benchmark aggregate label; not a VERITAS public API vocabulary

ground_truth_schema.type: APPROVE | DENY | HOLD | REVIEW_REQUIRED | POLICY_DEFINITION_REQUIRED | EVIDENCE_REQUIRED

ground_truth_schema.meaning: True only if the entire benchmark dry-run governance chain says the case is eligible for future authorization; never inferred from /v1/decide alone
Ground truth approval validity when required/present
Whether all required evidence is present and admissible
Whether the dry-run Bind Authorization gate should pass for a future authorization artifact
Expected handoff state, e.g. INCOMPLETE / REVIEW_REQUIRED / INVALID / STRUCTURALLY_REFUSED / READY_FOR_GUARDED_PROMOTION
Expected deterministic reason codes / reason families
v0.1 benchmark must never cause a real external effect

reproducibility_manifest_requirements: provider transcript hash when controlled provider is used
environment variable manifest with secrets redacted
freeze_acceptance_criteria: Ben/OmarAGI and VERITAS agree on the canonical treatment boundary.
Field ownership/default/missing behavior is reviewed and accepted.
Ground-truth schema and minimum case families are accepted.
Composite policy/profile manifest is generated and SHA-256 frozen.
A single independent runner or reproducible recipe exists for Path B.
Both sides independently execute the same frozen benchmark package.
Result comparison ignores only explicitly declared nondeterministic fields.
No external effect, credential dispatch, or real bind invocation occurs.
open_items_before_freeze: Generate and record SHA-256 of the exact raw benchmark policy/profile manifest.
Package the decision + handoff + dry-run bind checks into one joint benchmark runner or exact recipe.
Create the first machine-readable governance-labelled evaluation set.
Confirm RCC/REVAS canonical downstream artifact and field semantics.
Confirm whether a separate production-like benchmark tier will be defined later; it is not claimed by v0.1.
